output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov_2025
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_revenue = true
  AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Average order value for fiscal year 2025 (the same as calendar year 2025) is total net revenue from completed orders (is_revenue = true) divided by the number of completed orders placed in 2025. Cancelled, returned and open orders are left out, and so are shipping fees. The result is rounded to 2 decimals.
